items.text: #BeTheMatch is a MN-based organization that facilitates lifesaving bone marrow donations that can treat patients with life-threatening illnesses. If you’re interested in bone marrow donation, visit their website at https://t.co/aygHVEO2e9.

The Medicare enrollment period is now open! If you need assistance signing up for Medicare or Medicare Advantage coverage, visit https://t.co/bD0ioav89B or speak to a member of my team by calling (507) 577-6151. https://t.co/wDy3GY1p7K

Wastewater treatment plants are vital for the health and growth of rural communities. Glad to speak with Reps. @pmueller28 & @PeggyABennett as well as Senator @GeneDornink about the importance of this issue in #MN01. https://t.co/GPKO2ukt8i

Glad to meet with @madeliahealth to hear firsthand about their work as a leading health care provider in #MN01. Rural healthcare is vital to our communities, which is why I've been a strong supporter of legislation to help ensure the long-term stability of our rural hospitals. https://t.co/7NoME0Ooqx

Congratulations to @MayoClinic Rochester for being named the best hospital in the world for the 6th straight year! Because of their compassion and dedication to patient care, they have created a strong legacy of medical excellence for generations to come!
https://t.co/Kj1IkG8pnE

Medical organizations in #MN01 have a proud history as leaders in the healthcare industry, paving the way for innovation, especially in rural communities. Thanks @MedicalAlley for inviting me to give an update from DC and to discuss the challenges the medical industry is facing. https://t.co/dnFaPm2pRK

Great to meet with members of @AmerDentalAssn and dental students to discuss important legislation such as the DOC Access Act, which ensures patients receive fair and transparent pricing when seeking dental and vision healthcare. Thanks for stopping by. https://t.co/99hXae8w05

@bravozuluhouse, the nation’s only all-military post-treatment sober home, provides a safe space and resources to help veterans who suffer from Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder and addiction.

Honored to attend the groundbreaking event in Winnebago alongside Post 36 American Legion Commander Steve Fosness, Purple Heart recipient Jack Zimmerman, and Executive Director Tim Murray and hear about the important work that Bravo Zulu House does to support those who have sacrificed so much to protect us.
Happy to see that my friend and colleague, @CongressmanGT, has finished his cancer treatment. Wishing him a speedy and full recovery.

Thank you to the nurses in #MN01 and around the country who are on the front lines, ensuring that patients receive the highest quality care possible. During #NationalNursesWeek, we celebrate their compassion, hard work, and dedication. https://t.co/819s95TWUJ

#MN01 is home to the most cutting-edge medical innovation in the world. I’m proud to introduce this resolution with @RepDanCrenshaw to protect critical medical tests from overregulation & strengthen the relationship between innovation & patient care. https://t.co/m7zosLfSwB

Thank you to the Hormel Institute for hosting me and so many local healthcare leaders to discuss the challenges they face such as workforce shortages and supply chain disruptions. I look forward to future conversations regarding how we can work together in developing innovative solutions to enhance the future of healthcare in Minnesota for generations to come.

During my time in Congress, I have had the opportunity to meet with the outstanding rural hospitals, providers, and health systems we have here in #MN01. On #RuralHealthDay, we celebrate and recognize their commitment to providing high-quality care for all people in America, no matter where they live.

While access to care is declining throughout much of rural America, @uhdcare in Blue Earth has continued to expand care and bring in new patients. Proud to have such outstanding rural healthcare facilities right here in our backyard. https://t.co/O9ID0BXiJT

I’ve met with healthcare providers across #MN01 who’ve experienced the direct impact of the border crisis. Instead of pushing to secure our borders, @GovTimWalz has shifted the burden to rural healthcare systems and hard-working taxpayers. https://t.co/6WlxpfSYYU

This week, I met with @MedicalAlley to receive an update and discuss legislation that will make healthcare more accessible, especially in rural communities.  I appreciate all that they do to drive the future of healthcare forward and pave the way for medical innovation. https://t.co/n4yPKFZk7l

🚨ATTN veterans in Freeborn, Mower, and Faribault Counties🚨

The @DeptVetAffairs will be hosting a Veterans Resource Fair and Claims Clinic on January 23rd at the Albert Lea Armory from 11:00-3:00. Click the link for more information https://t.co/8OiWW9wM4E

Patients across #MN01 rely on lifesaving tests that they can receive close to home. @RepDanCrenshaw and I are taking steps to protect patients and rural healthcare providers from overregulation. https://t.co/e7pPLMXuB2

Access to telemedicine has been life-changing for those who live in rural communities. I joined @RepNikkiB in introducing the Rural Wellness Act, which will expand access to telehealth services for those who need it most. https://t.co/k2G6W45ZPA

I’m proud to serve in Congress to help bring resources back to our #MN01 communities. This week, I met with Mayor John Whittington and Jennifer Bromeland from Eagle Lake to hear about their city’s water treatment improvement project and discuss opportunities to partner in delivering infrastructure investments for their residents.

This is a win for patients and labs in #MN01!

Recently, I introduced the Freedom for Laboratory Innovation and Testing Act—critical legislation that protects lifesaving diagnostic tests from this burdensome rule that, if enacted, would have put lives at risk and hindered innovation

Today’s budget resolution sets the table for compassionate improvements to Medicare, Medicaid, & Social Security. We can and will protect benefits for the most vulnerable among us while also rooting out the waste, fraud, and abuse. I'm grateful for @SpeakerJohnson's commitment to safeguarding these programs for those most in need.

In Congress, my top priority is advocating for the needs of our #MN01 communities. My office recently helped the @cityofalbertlea secure $1,000,000 in federal funding for much-needed wastewater treatment facility improvements. I enjoyed visiting with Mayor Rich Murray and city staff this week to talk about the many ways we can continue to make a difference for Albert Lea’s residents.

I had the incredible opportunity to visit @MayoClinic's Department of Radiation Oncology and get an up-close look at some of their cutting-edge radiation technology. Mayo’s Edge and Ethos treatment machines give doctors and patients real-time information with millimeter precision, allowing treatments to be adjusted each day that a cancer patient’s anatomy changes.

This technology is truly game-changing for cancer treatment and is just one of many reasons I am working to ensure Mayo has the support and resources to continue the numerous life-saving trials and research projects that will lead to a cure for this terrible disease.

I had a great conversation with Troy Hewitt, owner of Hewitt Docks, Lifts & Pontoon Legs, when I stopped into their facility in Nicollet this week. We talked about some of the burdens their business is facing with increasing insurance costs and government overregulation, both of which impact their growth and bottom line.

#MN01 family-owned operations, like Hewitt, are exactly why I introduced my legislation, the Prove It Act – to make life easier for our small businesses by giving them a greater voice in the regulatory process.
